{{Quote|A Full System! There's only one hand that can beat that, and the odds against you holding it are astronomical.|The scout, to Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars 84">[[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]]</ref>}}
A '''Full System''' was one of the best hands in a card game played between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and a former [[Unidentified Imperial scout|Imperial scout]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Solo and the man agreed to [[Gambling/Legends|wager]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] against a [[Key crystal|crystal]] and [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] to [[Seoul 5]]. The [[Scout/Legends|scout]] played a Full System, but Solo still managed to win the round. Subsequently, Solo was accused of cheating, and a fight broke out.<ref name="Star Wars 84" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Full System first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]], which was written by [[Roy Richardson]], pencilled by [[David Mazzucchelli]], and published in [[1984]].<ref name="Star Wars 84" />
